headline.purpose: Site name in the top bar.

title.purpose: Incident title, the station name of a row.

body-detail.purpose: Summary and Easy text in an opened row, 46rem measure.

label.purpose: Group headings, field labels, button text.

meta.purpose: Ages, status, CVSS number and rating, risk word, footer.

description.purpose: Incident title under the CVE ID, two lines at most.

motion.name: chevron-turn
motion.purpose: Row chevron when a row opens; off under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Theme, language and copy-command buttons; the shared .btn.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--edge, #6b737c); border-radius: 8px; background: none; color: var(--ink, #ececec); font: 500 0.875rem/1 var(--sans, system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--panel-2, #1f2328); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7cc4ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: View Switch
components.description: The one 기본|쉬운 설명 switch at the top of the Board.
components.css: .ds-views { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--edge, #6b737c); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--panel-2, #1f2328); } .ds-views button { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: none; color: var(--ink-2, #a8afb7); font: 500 15px/1 var(--sans, system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-views button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink, #ececec); color: var(--bg, #121417); font-weight: 700; } .ds-views button:not([aria-pressed="true"]):hover { color: var(--ink, #ececec); } .ds-views button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7cc4ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Product picker and search box, one line on wide screens.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; background: var(--panel, #191c20); border: 1px solid var(--edge, #6b737c); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--ink, #ececec); } .ds-field:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7cc4ff); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-field svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--ink-3, #8c949d); flex: none; } .ds-field input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 46px; border: 0; background: none; outline: 0; color: inherit; font: 400 15px var(--sans, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3, #8c949d); }

components.name: Product Line Badge
components.description: A Product in its fixed subway-line colour.
components.css: .ds-ln { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 26px; padding: 3px 11px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--line); color: var(--line-ink); font: 600 0.78125rem/1.2 var(--sans, system-ui, sans-serif); }

components.name: CVSS Ring
components.description: CVSS score as a ring filled to score/10, number inside, coloured by rating.
components.html: 7.5
components.css: .ds-gauge { position: relative; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; color: var(--mid, #f5b400); } .ds-gauge svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; transform: rotate(-90deg); } .ds-gauge circle { fill: none; stroke-width: 3.5; } .ds-gauge .track { stroke: var(--rule-2, #3a4048); } .ds-gauge .arc { stroke: currentColor; stroke-dasharray: var(--fill) 1; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-gauge b { position: relative; font: 700 0.8125rem var(--sans, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #ececec); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Board Row
components.description: One Incident as a sign: risk dot and word, CVE ID over the title, CVSS ring, line badges, age.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 6.5rem minmax(0,1fr) 2.75rem auto 5.5rem; align-items: center; column-gap: 1.25rem; width: 100%; min-height: 72px; padding: 12px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #2a2f35); background: none; color: var(--ink, #ececec); text-align: left; font: 400 15px/1.55 var(--sans, system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--panel-2, #1f2328); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7cc4ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-risk { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--high, #ff6b62); } .ds-dot { width: 0.875rem; height: 0.875rem; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-title { display: block; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.35; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-sub { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink-2, #a8afb7); } .ds-cve { font-size: 0.875rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-age { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink-2, #a8afb7); justify-self: end; } .ds-ln { display: inline-flex; min-height: 26px; align-items: center; padding: 3px 11px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--line); color: var(--line-ink); font-size: 0.78125rem; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Highlight Frame
components.description: A 주목 Incident framed like a stacked emergency alert.
components.html:
SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN 인증 우회

다른 로그인 방식의 정상 계정을 가진 사람이 SAML 로그인과 추가 인증 확인 없이 회사 VPN에 들어올 수 있습니다.
components.css: .ds-alert { padding: 12px 16px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--high, #ff6b62) 7%, transparent), transparent 40%), var(--panel, #191c20); border: 1px solid var(--rule-2, #3a4048); border-left: 3px solid var(--high, #ff6b62); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px -8px var(--shadow, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.32)); color: var(--ink, #ececec); font: 400 15px/1.55 var(--sans, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-alert p { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.7; }

components.name: Command Line
components.description: A source-quoted command with a copy button.
components.css: .ds-command { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0; } .ds-command code { font: 0.875rem/1.5 var(--mono, ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace); background: var(--panel-2, #1f2328); border: 1px solid var(--rule-2, #3a4048); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; color: var(--ink, #ececec); } .ds-command button { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--edge, #6b737c); border-radius: 8px; background: none; color: var(--ink, #ececec); font: 500 0.875rem var(--sans, system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-command button:hover { background: var(--panel-2, #1f2328); } .ds-command button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7cc4ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The Board is read the way a commuter reads a Seoul subway sign: no column labels, no legend, just a coloured line, a bold station name and the line under it that says where it goes. Every Product rides its own fixed line colour, every CVE ID is set like a station name with the Incident's title under it, the CVSS score is a ring filled to its value, and the reader understands a row in one glance. Risk sits apart from the lines as a filled dot at the row start, so "which line" and "how dangerous" never share a colour.

Density is that of a departure board: rows of 72 px minimum, one hairline between them, generous column gaps, nothing decorative. The ground is graphite at night and pale concourse paper by day; the visitor's system setting picks one and a remembered toggle overrides it. The only thing that lifts off the ground is the "주목" group, stacked like emergency alerts in thin framed rows with a risk-coloured edge.

The Normal view is restrained: calm type, quiet colour, the facts. The Easy view is the same board with a friendlier voice: the risk word gains its "!", the row leads with a plain headline ("SonicWall VPN 인증 우회 위험 발견") over one plain sentence in Sign Ink, and each opened row ends in one plain action line set heavier than the text around it. The sign does not change; only the announcement does.
keyCharacteristics: No column header row; the row's grid position carries the meaning.
Two separate colour alphabets: risk and severity (red, amber, slate) and Product lines
The CVE ID as the bold name over the Incident title, like a station name over its direction.
CVSS as a ring filled to the score out of 10, number inside.
Flat rows on hairlines; only the Highlight frames carry a shadow.
Light and dark twins from one set of `light-dark()` tokens.

rules.name: The Two Alphabets Rule
rules.body: Risk and severity speak only in red, amber and slate, and the same severity is always the same colour; Product lines never use a red, orange, amber or grey hue, and a line colour never signals risk. Adding a line colour means checking it against all three first.

rules.name: The Fixed Line Rule
rules.body: A Product's line colour is a function of its Product id (never its translated name), the same on every row, language and visit. Never pick a line colour per page or per row.

rules.name: The Station Name Rule
rules.body: In the normal view the CVE ID is the bold name and the Incident title in the page language sits under it in Description size, cut after two lines. With more CVEs the name adds "외 N건". The Easy view leads with the Summary's plain headline over its one plain sentence (the opened panel starts with the CVE IDs) (Sign Ink, 500, never cut); without a Summary, and for an Incident with no CVE yet, the title leads and the CVE line goes under it.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: CVE IDs, counts, dates and times use tabular numerals so columns of numbers do not shimmer.

rules.name: The No Header Row Rule
rules.body: The Board never shows a row of column labels. If a column needs a label to be understood, the column is wrong.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Only the "주목" frames cast a shadow. Plain rows, fields, buttons and opened details stay flat.

dos: Do use the `:root` tokens (`--tap`, `--r-ctl`, `--r-frame`, `--r-pill`, `--fs-meta`, `--fs-small`) and the shared `.btn` for any new outlined button.
Do keep every interactive target at least 44 px.
Do theme browser surfaces from the palette: selection, caret, scrollbar, focus ring, link underline offset (3px).
Do keep Normal view calm and let the Easy view carry the louder voice (levels 심각! / 경계 / 주의, "!" only at 심각, a plain headline, one plain sentence that may end in "!", one action line at weight 600).
Do check both themes for WCAG 2.2 AA contrast after any colour change.
Do write a device or Product badge with its vendor in front.
donts: Don't add a column header row to the Board.
Don't give a Product line a red, amber or grey hue, or use a line colour for risk.
Don't put shadows on plain rows, fields or buttons; the Highlight frame is the only lift.
Don't widen the Highlight's risk edge past 3px or add a coloured edge to plain rows.
Don't set a column of numbers without tabular numerals.
